merge_from_protobuf_message: merge the contents of one protobuf message into another using MergeFrom
copy_from_protobuf_message: copy all fields from one protobuf message to another using CopyFrom
parse_protobuf_from_string: parse serialized protobuf bytes into a message using ParseFromString
serialize_protobuf_to_string: serialize a protobuf message to binary bytes using SerializeToString
list_protobuf_message_fields: list all non-empty fields of a protobuf message using ListFields
